description: This file defines the class 'FieldConfigStorage' which manages storage and retrieval of field configuration data within Drupal, including handling deleted fields and loading fields based on properties.

classes.name: FieldConfigStorage
classes.description: A storage handler class for managing field configuration data, including loading, deleting, and handling deleted fields within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage handler with dependencies such as entity type manager, field type manager, and deleted fields repository.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of the storage handler from a container and entity type.

methods.name: importDelete
methods.description: Handles the import deletion process, skipping deletion if the old config indicates the field was already deleted.

methods.name: loadByProperties
methods.description: Loads fields based on specified properties, including handling deleted fields and filtering by conditions.
